findings: World-space mat and shadows establish depth; original is still the default.
Studio surround is curved to avoid a hard floor/sky seam.
Sunset is an atmospheric gradient without a floor.
The same settings work in the generic GLB viewer.
Hardware post-processing uses up to 4 MSAA samples, with pixel density capped at 2; software fallback uses native 1x instead of 0.75x.
limits: These are presentation samples, not a calibrated photographic room. Existing HDR reflections are retained.
Model geometry and texture artwork were not regenerated.
Mat dimensions are established only for the authored millimeter-based Murph; normalized unknown objects have no measurement labels.
Glass appearance is angle-dependent; opacity and transmission remain constant.
No performance, model-fidelity or production-readiness score increase is claimed.
